description: Linux CI drill proving context cancellation after a supervised worker has emitted a complete frame interrupts the blocked pipe read promptly, returns context.Canceled instead of waiting for wall-clock timeout, reaps the process group before return, removes partial spool state and allows independently verified same-spool recovery. This is not host restart or production artifact evidence.
requiredAssertions: worker emits a complete accepted frame before cancellation
supervisor has written non-empty spool data before cancellation
cancellation returns context.Canceled within one second
cancellation does not wait for the ten-second wall-clock limit
partial spool attempt is removed before Parse returns
same manager and spool ID accept a replacement worker
replacement output passes independent spool verification
implementationGuards: context cancellation advances the output pipe read deadline
context error is checked immediately after readFrame returns
deferred process-group SIGKILL and command.Wait remain active
worker harness emits one complete frame before sleeping
limitations: one worker process in one process group
child-process orphan scan is not independently measured
host or container restart is not executed
test worker artifact rather than reviewed production artifact
